# DailyDotKids

> Daycare management software for licensed childcare centres in Canada and the USA.
> Product of Anthor Canada corp (Langley, British Columbia). Centre data hosted in Google Cloud Canada (Montréal) for now.

## Product
- Three apps: Admin (owners/directors), Teacher (educators), Parent (families)
- Free plan: self-serve in Admin app, no credit card — 1 location, 1 class, 8 students, 2 teachers, 16 parent accounts
- Paid plan: unlimited capacity + compliance tools (credentials vault, billing/invoice tracking, safety logbook, licensing visit prep & export)
- Does NOT process parent tuition payments (centres collect Interac/other themselves; apps track invoices)
- Does NOT certify regulatory compliance or replace a facility licence
